# Georgia Institute of Technology <span class='zh-inline'>(佐治亚理工学院)</span>

<img src="logos/gatech.svg" alt="Georgia Institute of Technology identifier" width="150" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1.4rem 0">

A technology institute whose computing college produced Google News, SQLite and the Pragmatic Programmer.

> 这所理工学院的计算学院孕育了 Google News、SQLite 和《程序员修炼之道》。

## Background (背景)

Established in 1885 as the Georgia School of Technology and opened in 1888 to 84 students, it was renamed Georgia Institute of Technology in 1948.

> 1885 年以“佐治亚技术学校”之名创立，1888 年招收 84 名学生，1948 年更名为佐治亚理工学院。

## Notable people (名人)

**Krishna Bharat** — created Google News during his MIT/Georgia Tech CS studies. **D. Richard Hipp** (1984) — architect and primary author of the SQLite database engine. **Andy Hunt** — co-author of *The Pragmatic Programmer* and an original signatory of the Agile Manifesto.

> **Krishna Bharat** — 在开发 Google News 前于佐治亚理工取得计算机硕士与博士学位。**D. Richard Hipp**（1984 届）— SQLite 数据库引擎的架构师与主要作者。**Andy Hunt** — 《程序员修炼之道》合著者、敏捷宣言签署人。

## Notable CS courses (著名计算机课程)

CS 1301 Introduction to Computing · CS 1331 Object-Oriented Programming · CS 1332 Data Structures and Algorithms · CS 3510 Design and Analysis of Algorithms · CS 3600 Introduction to AI.

> CS 1301 计算导论 · CS 1331 面向对象编程 · CS 1332 数据结构与算法 · CS 3510 算法设计与分析 · CS 3600 人工智能导论。
